description:
### Added
- **Hide Spotlight Ad** — hides the sponsored "Spotlight" ad card on the home
  feed (the "AD"-badged card next to "Popular this week"). On by default,
  toggleable independently of the other three patches.

### Changed
- README now recommends pairing this repo with
  [De-Vanced](https://github.com/RookieEnough/De-Vanced) for Letterboxd's
  AdMob banner/interstitial ads and the locked alternate app icons, which
  this repo doesn't touch.
